audit_notes: AUDIT FAILED - REQUEST PHYSICALLY IMPOSSIBLE (third concept, same root cause). A closed, adiabatic system without energy input cannot deliver sustained net heat to a house, and heat output > energy input (efficiency > 300 %) violates the first law of thermodynamics. This is independent of the concept; further re-mining is futile. Technical check of the SUBSTITUTE (open system, ground-coupled termite-mound-like gallery surface): parameters plausible (soil 2 m, k=1.8 W/mK, T_ground=283 K, T_surface=278 K). Linear profile T(x)=283-5x; conductive flux k*dT/d = 1.8*5/2 = 4.5 W/m2 from ground to exchanger; energy conserved, the ground is the source; no structural or thermal issues. This does not fulfil the stated requirement. Recommendation: terminate and tell the user the request is impossible; realistic alternatives are heat pumps (COP 3-5 as ratio of heat to electrical work, with ambient/ground heat input), passive solar gains and better insulation.
